description: Implementation of WebSocket basic stream handling, including reading, writing, frame parsing, and control frame management within the Chromium project.

classes.name: WebSocketBasicStream
classes.description: Handles WebSocket frame reading, writing, and parsing, including control frame management and buffer size adaptation.

classes.name: WebSocketBasicStream::BufferSizeManager
classes.description: Manages dynamic buffer sizing based on network throughput.

methods.name: ReadFrames
methods.description: Reads WebSocket frames from the connection.

methods.name: WriteFrames
methods.description: Serializes and writes WebSocket frames to the connection.

methods.name: CreateWebSocketBasicStreamForTesting
methods.description: Creates a WebSocketBasicStream instance for testing purposes with custom masking key generator.

methods.name: ReadEverything
methods.description: Performs reading of data and parsing into frames until completion or error.

methods.name: OnReadComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of a read operation.

methods.name: WriteEverything
methods.description: Performs writing of buffered data to the connection.

methods.name: OnWriteComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of a write operation.

methods.name: HandleReadResult
methods.description: Processes the result of a read operation, including error handling and frame parsing.

methods.name: ConvertChunksToFrames
methods.description: Converts raw frame chunks into complete WebSocket frames.

methods.name: ConvertChunkToFrame
methods.description: Converts a single frame chunk into a WebSocket frame.

methods.name: CreateFrame
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket frame from payload data and header info.

methods.name: AddToIncompleteControlFrameBody
methods.description: Accumulates payload data for split control frames.
